bio: Kamiwa’s Dynasty carries a strange gift, at least for a Cambion: serenity so profound it is a magic of its own. It is a gift that Kamiwa cannot help but treasure, for she is constantly reminded of its worth – thousands of Cambion seek her every year, just to share a moment of the peace she carries.
